recentItems.title: Fanni Pigniczki making Hungary Proud 👏🤩 | Rhythmic Gymnastics Qualification - Hoop  | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
Lean back and enjoy Fanni Pigniczki of Hungary performing her Hoop routine in the Rhythmic Gymnastics qualification at the Olympic Games Paris 2024.

Pigniczki scored 32.650 points with the Hoop, finishing 11th. Across all four routines, she achieved a total score of 127.350 points to place 12th in the Individual All-Around qualification.

recentItems.title: "I Hope My Story Inspires One Person" 🏊‍♀️🇿🇦 | Women's 100m Breaststroke | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

South Africa's 27-year-old Tatjana Smith came into her second as the defending champion in her pet 200m breaststroke event and with silver in the 100m distance of Tokyo 2020. At Paris 2024, she claimed cold with a time of 1:05.28, as the People's Republic of China's Qianting Tang took silver and Ireland's Mona McSharry completed the podium.
